ordinals.summary: Image viewer grab before window mapping caused Tcl failure; lifecycle-aware deferred grab plus explicit Save As effect added.
Deterministic file-search intent was hijacked by broader agentic regex; specific handler precedence was added.
Multiple slash-command templates did not match router regexes and silently fell through to generic chat.
File-search subprocess invocation used mutually incompatible capture options and crashed at runtime.
Large cross-codebase cleanup replaced bare except with Exception handling so SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt were not swallowed.
Added pyproject pytest/ruff config, pinned dependency ranges, removed duplicate dependency and filled missing package/dependency declarations.
Removed broad hardcoded developer paths and DISPLAY assumptions; shell/runtime paths became environment/root-derived.
Runtime/user databases and machine-specific config were removed from git tracking and added to ignore rules; historical source state had conflated runtime personal state with repository artifacts.
Historical hardcoded credential material was removed and secret/API configuration shifted to environment-based configuration; test credentials were made synthetic.
PTT voice path was switched from a separate mini-router to the full command router, aligning typed and spoken tool semantics.
Introduced local file search and clickable file URIs plus streaming-scroll intent preservation and service-health correction; later commits expose routing/subprocess defects in this initial path.
Resize strategy synchronized width live while deferring scrollregion updates to reduce jump/reflow instability.
Throttled resize optimization caused a layout cascade loop and was reverted to suppressed drag/deferred final layout.
Earlier resize optimization throttled canvas updates/deferred expensive remeasurement; subsequent k396 shows this approach regressed via layout cascade.
Legacy therapeutic fallback changed transient/network errors from immediate failure to bounded retry/backoff.
Entity agents stopped emitting completion notifications when summary generation failed and added retry/backoff for transient failures.

security_note: Historical secret-bearing source was inspected only to establish the correction lineage. Credential values are not reproduced in this manifest or any research artifact.
